title: Magyar Denies Rumors That He and Economy Minister Kapitány Will Resign
detail: PM Péter Magyar denied reports that he and Economy and Energy Minister István Kapitány were planning to resign, calling the coverage debunked lies on Facebook. The rumors followed the departure of energy state secretary András Tótth after controversy over a planned battery industry conference in Debrecen; HVG sources said Kapitány's exit had been discussed, which the ministry officially denied.

media.caption: Energy state secretary resigns after battery conference controversy
